dialogue.speaker: orange
dialogue.text: I could never forget the day you were born. If you didn't exist, who would the love of my life be?

dialogue.speaker: orange
dialogue.text: Spending so much of my life being hopelessly in love with you has made me a little dramatic <3

dialogue.speaker: purple
dialogue.text: This is so nice. I haven't been here in so long!

dialogue.speaker: orange
dialogue.text: We should come here more often.

dialogue.speaker: purple
dialogue.text: Maybe! I'd love to come with my friends sometime, too. We used to come here all the time.

dialogue.speaker: purple
dialogue.text: Yeah! I was thinking, I could ask them if they want to do a picnic here next weekend?

dialogue.speaker: orange
dialogue.text: You have time to spend with them, but not with me?

dialogue.speaker: purple
dialogue.text: What are you talking about? That's not what I meant–

dialogue.speaker: orange
dialogue.text: What do you wanna do with them that you can't do with me?

dialogue.speaker: purple
dialogue.text: We can still do something together. I just haven't seen them in a while. I hate when you get so unreasonable.

dialogue.speaker: orange
dialogue.text: Unreasonable? I knew planning anything nice for you was a mistake.

choices.text: If I'm a mistake, then you should leave. Leave me alone. I don't need you ruining my special day.
I'm sorry… I didn't mean it.
